about: Image and media registry for the My Dealer redesign (IMAGERY lane). photos: the client's own photos and film stills (alts reuse the captured alts where they exist). generated: AI-generated illustrative stills in assets/generated (the build makes WebP variants; use gimg(id)). media: the AI smoke loop and the client's brand film.

loop-smoke.use: seamless loop (forward then reverse): muted, loop, playsinline, decorative (aria-hidden); show the poster and do not autoplay under prefers-reduced-motion
loop-smoke.note: AI-generated illustrative motion (Higgsfield kling-video/v3.0-turbo/image-to-video, animated from the AI-generated still g-smoke; forward-then-reverse loop). IPTC digital source type: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/digitalsourcetype/trainedAlgorithmicMedia. Not footage of My Dealer (mydealermn.com), its store, staff, customers, products or brands.

brand-film.note: The client's own brand film (the dealer character comes to life): the home hero film, as on the live site. Not made by this redesign and not AI-generated by it.

g-bud-macro.alt: Macro photograph of a frosty cured cannabis flower bud with amber pistils on dark weathered wood beside a small turquoise stone, rim-lit in warm light against an indigo night background with soft star-like bokeh
g-bud-macro.style: bud left of centre with a turquoise stone to its right; indigo star-like bokeh across the top; darkest along the bottom edge

g-deli-jars.alt: Three open clear glass jars of cured cannabis flower on a weathered dark wooden plank between two turquoise stones, with a candle and dried sage in the background against an indigo night background with soft bokeh
g-deli-jars.style: three jars centred on a plank; a candle and dried sage at the far left; indigo bokeh above the jars

g-prerolls.alt: Three unlit pre-rolls on a hammered brass plate, their open ends packed with ground flower, beside loose flower crumbs on dark wood, with a lantern glowing in the background
g-prerolls.style: brass plate right of centre; a lantern at the top left; loose flower at the left and lower left

g-edibles.alt: Square amber gummies in a small terracotta dish on a dark wooden round beside two turquoise stones and a sprig of dried herbs, with a lantern glowing in the background against an indigo night background
g-edibles.style: dish slightly right of centre; a lantern at the top left; turquoise stones at the lower right; a blurred dark cloth at the top right

g-vape.alt: An unbranded matte black all-in-one vape device with a small amber oil window, lying on dark tooled leather beside a brass bowl and two turquoise stones, with a lantern glowing behind
g-vape.style: device centre right on tooled leather; a lantern at the top left; a brass bowl at the right

g-beverage.alt: Two blank unlabelled matte cans, one terracotta and one cream, beaded with condensation on weathered dark wood beside a sprig of dried sage, against an indigo night background with soft bokeh
g-beverage.style: two cans right of centre; calm dark indigo space across the left half

g-smoke.alt: Soft wisps of pale smoke curling across a near-black background with a faint warm glow
g-smoke.style: texture; mostly near-black with a warm glow at the top right

s-leaf.alt: Engraving-style ink drawing of a cannabis fan leaf with a crescent moon, small stars and sun rays
s-leaf.ground: pure white paper (#fff): multiply onto cream, invert(1) + screen onto ink
s-leaf.style: engraving: fine hatching, near mirror symmetry; crescent moon at the upper left, small stars and a sun-ray halo behind the leaf

s-bud.alt: Engraving-style ink drawing of a cannabis flower bud on its stem among fan leaves, with a crescent moon, small stars and sun rays
s-bud.ground: pure white paper (#fff): multiply onto cream, invert(1) + screen onto ink
s-bud.style: engraving: dense hatching on the bud, fan leaves at the base; crescent moon on the axis above; sun-ray halo

s-jar.alt: Engraving-style ink drawing of an empty apothecary jar with a domed lid and a knob, with a crescent moon, small four-point stars and sun rays
s-jar.ground: pure white paper (#fff): multiply onto cream, invert(1) + screen onto ink
s-jar.style: engraving: fine hatching, mirror symmetry; crescent moon above the knob; sun-ray halo; hatched floor shadow under the jar

s-hat.alt: Engraving-style ink drawing of a fedora hat with folded sunglasses resting on its brim, with sun rays behind and a crescent moon and stars on the hat band (no person)
s-hat.ground: pure white paper (#fff): multiply onto cream, invert(1) + screen onto ink
s-hat.style: engraving: heavy hatching on the crown, dark band; sunglasses across the front of the brim; sun-ray halo
